about: Synthetic plain-text pitches for the D-33 pitch review. No real people. 'gaps' are the core topics the first reading must flag as not yet sufficient; 'facts' are what a simulated entrepreneur answers when asked (null = they say they have not decided).

cases.pitch:
I want to start a tailoring shop that stitches blouses, school uniforms and kurtis.
My customers are women and schools in Sinnar town: about 400 families and 3 schools nearby.
The shop will be in Sinnar town, Nashik district, Maharashtra.
I asked 30 women in my area and visited the market; most said they wait two weeks for a tailor.
I need cloth, thread, buttons and two sewing machines.
I will buy cloth and thread from wholesale shops in Nashik city.
There are two other tailors nearby but they are always busy and do not make school uniforms.
I need Rs 60000 to start: Rs 20000 from my savings and a loan of Rs 40000.
I will charge Rs 250 for a blouse.
I expect to stitch 120 blouses a month, so monthly sales of Rs 30000.

I plan to sell fresh cow milk and paneer from a small dairy at my home.
My buyers will be 60 households and two tea stalls in Kherdi village.
The dairy will run in Kherdi village, Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra.
For three weeks I sold milk from my one cow to neighbours and all of it sold every morning.
I need two more cows, a milk chiller, cans and cattle feed.
I will buy cows from the cattle market in Rahuri and feed from the cooperative society.
The cooperative collection centre buys milk at a low rate and nobody in the village sells paneer.
I need Rs 150000 in total: Rs 50000 of my own and a loan of Rs 100000 from the bank.
Milk will sell at Rs 60 per litre.
I expect to sell 1500 litres a month, about Rs 90000 of sales each month.

I will make and sell masala papad and pickles from my kitchen.
My customers are grocery shops and households in Wardha town, around 15 shops.
I will work from my home in Wardha town, Wardha district, Maharashtra.
I gave samples to 10 shops and 6 said they would stock them.
I need urad flour, spices, oil, jars and packets.
I will buy flour and spices from the wholesale market in Wardha.
Two big brands are sold in the shops but there is no local homemade papad.

facts.funding: I need Rs 25000 to start: Rs 10000 from my savings and a loan of Rs 15000 from my self-help group.
facts.unit_price: A packet of 20 papads will sell for Rs 60.
facts.monthly_revenue: I expect to sell 400 packets a month, so about Rs 24000 of sales a month.

cases.pitch:
I want to run a snack stall selling vada pav and tea near the bus stand.
My customers are travellers and college students, about 200 people pass every hour in the morning.
The stall will be at the Sangamner bus stand, Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra.
I need a cart, a stove, a gas cylinder, potatoes, oil and bread.
I will buy vegetables and bread daily from the Sangamner market.
I need Rs 40000 to start: Rs 15000 savings and a loan of Rs 25000.
One vada pav will cost Rs 15.
I expect to sell 60 vada pav a day, about Rs 27000 a month.

facts.market_research: I stood at the bus stand for three mornings and counted people buying snacks from the one other cart.
facts.competition: There is one other cart there; it sells only tea, not vada pav.

cases.pitch: I want to open a mobile phone repair shop.

facts.offering: I will repair mobile phones: screens, batteries and charging ports, and sell covers.
facts.customers: Students and shopkeepers in Malegaon town, about 300 people a month need repairs.
facts.location: A small shop near the market in Malegaon town, Nashik district, Maharashtra.
facts.market_research: I worked in a repair shop for two years and saw a queue of customers every day.
facts.raw_materials: I need a repair toolkit, a soldering station and spare screens and batteries.
facts.suppliers: I will buy spare parts from a wholesaler in Nashik city.
facts.funding: I need Rs 70000 to start: Rs 30000 from my savings and a loan of Rs 40000.
facts.competition: There are three repair shops in the town but they take three days for a screen.
facts.unit_price: A screen replacement will cost Rs 800 on average.
facts.monthly_revenue: I expect about 50 repairs a month, so about Rs 40000 a month.

cases.pitch:
I will start a small bakery making bread, buns and cakes.
Many people will buy from me.
The bakery will be in Pandharpur town, Solapur district, Maharashtra.
I baked cakes for 20 birthdays last year and people asked for more.
I need flour, sugar, butter, an oven and trays.
I will buy flour and sugar from a wholesaler in Solapur.
There are two bakeries in the town but they do not make custom cakes.
I need Rs 90000: Rs 30000 of my own and a loan of Rs 60000.
A cake will cost Rs 400.
I expect to sell 80 cakes a month, so Rs 32000 of sales a month.

facts.customers: Families and offices in Pandharpur who order birthday and festival cakes, around 80 orders a month.

cases.pitch:
I want to start a vegetable vending cart in the evening market.
My customers are families in Akluj town, about 150 households near the market.
The cart will be in Akluj town, Solapur district, Maharashtra.
I asked 20 families and they said they want fresh vegetables near their homes.
I need a cart, weighing scale and crates.
I will buy vegetables every morning from the wholesale market in Akluj.
There are four vendors but they are far from the new housing colony.
I need Rs 80000 to start: Rs 20000 from my savings and a loan of Rs 40000.
I will sell at about Rs 40 per kilogram.
I expect to sell 900 kilograms a month, so about Rs 36000 a month.

facts.funding: I need Rs 60000 to start: Rs 20000 from my savings and a loan of Rs 40000.

cases.pitch:
My family has five members and my father is a farmer.
I completed my studies in 2019 and I like cricket.
I want to do business because I want to be independent.
My village is very beautiful and people are good.

facts.offering: I will run a flour mill that grinds wheat and jowar for farmers.
facts.customers: Farmers and households in Shirpur village, about 300 families.
facts.location: In Shirpur village, Dhule district, Maharashtra.
facts.market_research: I asked 25 families and they travel 8 kilometres to grind grain.
facts.raw_materials: I need a grinding machine, an electric motor and sacks.
facts.suppliers: I will buy the machine from a dealer in Dhule city.
facts.funding: I need Rs 120000: Rs 40000 savings and a loan of Rs 80000.
facts.competition: There is no flour mill in the village; the nearest is 8 kilometres away.
facts.monthly_revenue: I expect to grind 6000 kilograms a month, so Rs 30000 a month.

cases.pitch:
I will open a beauty parlour offering haircuts, threading and bridal makeup.
My customers are women and young girls, about 250 in my area.
The parlour will be near the bus stand in my village.
I did a beauty course and served 40 customers at home last year.
I need chairs, a mirror, products and a hair dryer.
I will buy products from a beauty wholesaler in Jalna.
There is one parlour but it does not do bridal makeup.
I need Rs 70000: Rs 20000 savings and a loan of Rs 50000.
Threading costs Rs 30 and bridal makeup Rs 3000.
I expect monthly sales of Rs 25000.

facts.location: My village is Badnapur, in Jalna district, Maharashtra.

cases.pitch:
I want to make and sell cotton bags to shops.
My customers are grocery and cloth shops in Yavatmal town, about 40 shops.
I will work from home in Yavatmal town, Yavatmal district, Maharashtra.
I need cotton cloth, thread and a sewing machine.
I will buy cloth from a mill outlet in Yavatmal.
I need Rs 30000: Rs 10000 savings and a loan of Rs 20000.
One bag will sell for Rs 20.
I expect to sell 1200 bags a month, so Rs 24000 a month.

I will run a tiffin service delivering home-cooked lunch.
My customers are office workers and students in Latur city, about 50 regular customers.
The kitchen will be at my home in Latur city, Latur district, Maharashtra.
I cooked lunch for 12 office workers for a month and they want to continue.
There are two tiffin services but they deliver late.
I need Rs 35000: Rs 15000 savings and a loan of Rs 20000.
A lunch tiffin will cost Rs 80.
I expect to deliver 1000 tiffins a month, so Rs 80000 a month.

facts.raw_materials: I need rice, wheat flour, vegetables, oil, tiffin boxes and a bigger stove.
facts.suppliers: I will buy grain and oil from a wholesale shop in Latur and vegetables from the daily market.

cases.pitch:
I want to start a small poultry farm for eggs.
My buyers are bakeries and egg sellers in Baramati town, about 12 regular buyers.
The farm will be in Pimpli village, Pune district, Maharashtra.
I talked to 8 egg sellers and they buy eggs from far away farms.
I need 500 layer hens, cages, feeders and feed.
I will buy chicks and feed from the hatchery in Baramati.
There is one big farm 20 kilometres away and no farm in our village.
I need 1.5 lakh to start: 50k of my own and a loan of 1 lakh.
One egg sells for Rs 6.
I expect 12000 eggs a month, about Rs 72000 a month.

I want to sell tea from a stall.

facts.customers: Shopkeepers and travellers at the Shirdi market, about 300 cups a day.

cases.pitch:
I will sell handmade earthen pots and lamps.
My buyers are households and temples in Paithan town, about 100 regular buyers.
The workshop will be in Paithan town, Aurangabad district, Maharashtra.
I sold 300 lamps at the Diwali fair last year.
I need clay, a potter's wheel and a kiln.
I will buy clay from the river bank suppliers near Paithan.
There are two potters but they make only plain pots.
I need Rs 45000: Rs 15000 savings and a loan of Rs 30000.
A decorated lamp sells for Rs 50.
I expect to sell 600 lamps a month, so Rs 30000 a month.
You can call me on 98765 43210 or email me at synthetic.potter@example.com.

I want to open a goat rearing unit and sell goats for meat.
My buyers are meat shops and traders at the weekly market, about 10 traders.
I attended a goat rearing training and visited three farms.
I need 20 goats, a shed, fodder and medicines.
I will buy goats from the weekly market and fodder from local farmers.
I need Rs 200000: Rs 50000 savings and a loan of Rs 150000.
A grown goat sells for Rs 8000.
I expect to sell 6 goats a month, so Rs 48000 a month.

facts.location: The shed will be in Kopargaon village, Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra.
facts.competition: Two farmers rear goats nearby but they sell only during festivals.
